item.text: {"candidates":[{"query_id":"q01","reason":"Window counting followed by DISTINCT preserves NULL hour groups and BIGINT counts.","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT EXTRACT(hour FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) AS hour, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(hour FROM tpep_pickup_datetime)) AS trips FROM trips"},{"query_id":"q01","reason":"Two-stage aggregation preserves every row, NULL hour groups, and the original BIGINT result type.","sql":"SELECT hour, CAST(SUM(partial_trips) AS BIGINT) AS trips FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(hour FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) AS hour, PULocationID, COUNT(*) AS partial_trips FROM trips GROUP BY 1, 2) AS partial GROUP BY hour"},{"query_id":"q05","reason":"Window counting over qualifying rows preserves duplicate counts, NULL route keys, and the original calendar-day predicate.","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT PULocationID AS pickup, DOLocationID AS dropoff, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY PULocationID, DOLocationID) AS trips FROM trips WHERE EXTRACT(day FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) <= 7"},{"query_id":"q05","reason":"Filtered aggregation with HAVING preserves exactly the qualifying routes and BIGINT counts without restricting months or years.","sql":"SELECT PULocationID AS pickup, DOLocationID AS dropoff, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(day FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) <= 7) AS trips FROM trips GROUP BY 1, 2 HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(day FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) <= 7) > 0"}]}
